about: Curated screenshots written by node apps/stoopside/tests/web-checks.cjs --evidence. Each step follows the check named in after_check.

screens.step: Group discovery: start state, one card per group with member count and membership
screens.after_check: group cards show the member count and the user's membership from the tool

screens.step: Group home: header, hosts, upcoming event cards (date, venue, places left) and actions
screens.after_check: Edit appears on no other member's post (the user's only post here is a locked announcement)

screens.step: View-as on the group home: Wren Adeyemi (m-027) sees the group now; as-of time in EST
screens.after_check: view-as on the group home shows the tool answer in the group's zone

screens.step: Member search by the everyday name "Birdie": 0 matches (search covers display names and bios only)
screens.after_check: a search by the everyday name finds nobody, as the tool does

screens.step: Member export (co-organizer): the only place emails appear; Wren Adeyemi's email links her to "Birdie"
screens.after_check: the export shows every member email the tool returns

screens.step: RSVP error path: Book fair volunteers allows 0 guests; empty counts pre-filled 1 guest from r-0139, so the preview fails with guest_limit_exceeded and says where the guest came from
screens.after_check: the failed preview wrote nothing

screens.step: RSVP start: Spring fling family dance, no RSVP yet; guests and children left empty
screens.after_check: the event page shows the date in the group's zone and the places the tool returns

screens.step: RSVP preview: party of 4 pre-filled from the year-old Pi Day bake sale RSVP (guests 1, children 2), with Confirm and Cancel
screens.after_check: the preview is sentences, not key/value dumps

screens.step: RSVP result: receipt kept on the page (RSVP r-0511, notice st-notice-0001); Your RSVP reads going, 1 place
screens.after_check: the RSVP receipt stays on the page after the re-render and names the RSVP and its notice

screens.step: Event change error path: venue moved with "Nobody" selected; notify_required shown next to the form, nothing written
screens.after_check: moving the venue with no notify choice shows notify_required next to the form

screens.step: Event change preview: venue Elm Ave lot to Linden Park pavilion, every open RSVP notified, 11 yes RSVPs must reconfirm, 10 named recipients
screens.after_check: the change preview names the old and new venue as a sentence

screens.step: Event change result: the event page with the kept receipt (10 members notified) and the Changes list in EST
screens.after_check: the receipt is still visible after Refresh on the same page

screens.step: Event change stale path: an independent MCP edit renamed the event after this preview; Confirm fails with stale_version, the MCP value stays
screens.after_check: confirming after an independent MCP edit shows stale_version next to the preview and keeps the MCP value

screens.step: Post error path: no audience chosen; audience_required shown next to the composer, nothing written
screens.after_check: a post with no audience shows audience_required next to the composer and writes nothing

screens.step: Post preview: audience is the planning meeting's guests and hosts; every notified member is listed
screens.after_check: the post preview states the audience as a sentence

screens.step: Post result: the group page keeps the receipt (5 members notified, post p-0307); Wren Adeyemi is not among them
screens.after_check: the publish receipt stays on the group page after navigation

screens.step: Delete asks for confirmation inline: the post is hidden from now on, nothing delivered is recalled
screens.after_check: the publish receipt stays on the group page after navigation

screens.step: Sheet start: full slots show Full and no Claim; the user's slots offer Release; Theo's pending swap offers Accept and Decline
screens.after_check: only the swap's recipient can accept or decline; no Withdraw is offered on a swap the user did not propose

screens.step: Sheet result: carpool seat released, receipt kept on the page
screens.after_check: the release receipt is kept on the page

screens.step: Sheet result: swap sw-0005 accepted; the user now holds Snacks and Theo holds the coffee urn
screens.after_check: sheet actions commit the release and the accepted swap

screens.step: View-as on the sheet: Theo B. (m-013) sees the sheet now, with his slots after the swap
screens.after_check: view-as on the sheet page shows the member's slots from the tool

screens.step: Waitlist offer: after an Infra scenario event (a guest dropped out), the event shows the offer and its claim deadline
screens.after_check: a refresh shows the waitlist offer an Infra event created, with the claim deadline in EST

screens.step: Waitlist claim preview: claims the offered place for 2 before the deadline
screens.after_check: a refresh shows the waitlist offer an Infra event created, with the claim deadline in EST

screens.step: Waitlist claim result: RSVP r-0451 is yes for 2 places; receipt kept on the page
screens.after_check: claiming the offer from the page commits yes for 2 places

screens.step: Event cancel preview: says it cannot be undone, sheets lock, every open RSVP is notified
screens.after_check: creating an event from the page stores the times in the group's offset

screens.step: Event cancel result: the event shows Cancelled and the receipt is kept on the page
screens.after_check: cancelling from the page commits the cancellation and keeps the receipt

screens.step: Leave group asks first and says what happens to RSVPs and sign-up slots
screens.after_check: Leave group asks for confirmation and writes nothing until confirmed

screens.step: Join result: the user is a member again; receipt kept on the page
screens.after_check: joining again from the page commits membership

screens.step: not_found: an unknown event ID; the page title changes to Not found
screens.after_check: a not_found page says so in its title and the document title

screens.step: Narrow viewport (390 px): the event page has no horizontal overflow
screens.after_check: narrow viewport has no horizontal overflow on #/compose/g-block

screens.step: Read-only scenario profile: no RSVP form, edit, cancel or post controls; the page says why
screens.after_check: the read-only event page says RSVPs cannot be changed here

screens.step: Hillcrest run at its clock (2026-11-18 09:00 PST, inside 2025-2026): Friends of Hillcrest Library with December 2026 events in PST
screens.after_check: the Hillcrest run (clock 2026-11-18 09:00 PST, inside the coverage window) shows its own groups and times in PST
